column1: # Frozen NCBI BLAST+ 2.17.0 -outfmt 0 fixtures (Session S06; authority and gate record: docs/evidence/losat_web_e2a/).
# Run every command from LOSAT/: <program> -query <query> -subject <subject> [-task <task>] <extra_args> -outfmt 0, output on stdout.
# The Database lines print the -subject argument literally, so the path spelling is part of the expected bytes.
# Expected output: tests/fixtures/outfmt0/<fixture_id>.out, and <fixture_id>.err when stderr_sha256 is set.
# The hash and size columns are written by docs/evidence/losat_web_e2a/run_oracle.py --freeze; do not edit them by hand.

column10: covers

2 queries x 2 subjects (blastn_parity_manifest compact input); Plus/Plus; Gapped BLAST reference; Database title wrapped at 68 in prolog and epilog; Karlin blocks without Gumbel columns; 'Matrix: blastn matrix 2 -3'; 2-digit coordinate width
megablast reference (eMegaBlast); 'BLASTN' header for megablast; 'Gap Penalties: Existence: 0, Extension: 2.5' (zero-extension formula); Karlin values of reward 1 / penalty -2
'***** No hits found *****' for every query, each followed by the full Karlin footer
no hits under megablast (megablast reference and footer values)

genome pair of blastn_parity_manifest (MelaMJNV.PemoMJNVA); 20 HSPs on one subject; Plus/Minus; gaps in both rows including a leading '-'; 6-digit coordinates; DUST lowercase in Query rows; Query= FlatFile wrap; subject defline wrapped at 60; description ellipsis; bit scores >= 1000

genome pair of blastn_parity_manifest (PesePMNV.MjPMNV) under task blastn; 241 HSPs on one subject; every E-value branch below 10 (0.0, NeNN, %4.3lf, %3.2lf, %2.1lf); bit scores below and above 100; many Plus/Minus; DUST lowercase

one subject with a Plus/Minus HSP (ranked first) and a Plus/Plus HSP; minus-strand Sbjct coordinates decrease across lines; a leading query-row gap and a subject-row gap; subject title wrapped at 60 with a trailing space; description truncated with '...'; 3-digit width
the same input under megablast (greedy traceback extents)
DUST-masked CA repeat shown lowercase in the Query row only; midline stays '|'; identities unaffected; E column '0.0' padded to 'Value'
-dust no: Query row fully uppercase (input lowercase is ignored without -lcase_masking)
-lcase_masking: input lowercase runs and the DUST region shown lowercase in the Query row
-lcase_masking -dust no: only the input lowercase runs shown lowercase
-lcase_masking under megablast
subject with a lowercase run and -lcase_masking: Sbjct row shown lowercase (subject masks)
control: the same subject without -lcase_masking; Sbjct row uppercase
3 queries x 6 subjects; a no-hit query between two hit queries; a query hitting only on the minus strand; a subject with one plus and one minus HSP
the same input under megablast
-max_target_seqs 3, below the subject count: at most 3 descriptions and 3 aligned subjects per query; stderr 'Examining 5 or more matches is recommended'
-max_target_seqs 1: one subject per query; the E column narrows to 'Value'; the same stderr warning
weak hits: 315 HSPs, many per subject; bit scores below 100 (%4.1lf); E values of 10 or more; also the regression input for the gapped-start subject bound (LOSAT panicked here before S07)
-max_hsps 1: one HSP per subject (the HSP selection reaches outfmt 0 as in outfmt 6)
-perc_identity 97: HSPs below 97% identity removed
-subject_besthit: HSPs contained in a better HSP of the same subject removed
non-default scores with zero gap costs under megablast: 'Matrix: blastn matrix 2 -3' and 'Gap Penalties: Existence: 0, Extension: 4' (zero-extension formula); outfmt 6 matches NCBI on this input
260 hit subjects: 260 descriptions (default 500) but 250 alignments (default 250)
an explicit -max_target_seqs sets descriptions = alignments = 255
an explicit -max_target_seqs 500 (the default hit list size) still raises the alignments from 250 to 260, so the formatter must know whether the option was given
coordinate-width boundary: the largest 0-based coordinate is 99, so the width is 2 and 'Sbjct  100 A  100' has one space
the same width boundary under megablast
invalid (all N) query: stderr Karlin-Altschul warning; No hits; footer with -1.00 Karlin blocks and 'Effective search space used: 0'
fully lowercase query with -lcase_masking: No hits with a normal Karlin footer; the second (uppercase) query hits normally

long deflines: Query= FlatFile wrap (comma, hyphen, forced break of a 70-character token); subject defline with an unbreakable token longer than 60; description ellipsis; a second subject without a hit
BLASTP coordinate-width boundary (subject positions 40-100): 'Sbjct  100 N  100' has one space; LOSAT printed two before S07
TBLASTN coordinate-width boundary (frame +2 ends at subject nucleotide 100): 'Sbjct  2   ...  100'; LOSAT printed one more space before S07
